==Overview==
During the Winter Solstice 381YE, the [[Synod]] raised 77 [[judgement|judgements]].

The successful [[recognition]] of Asher of Felix's Watch as a paragon by the Courage Assembly will be escalated to the General Assembly at the Spring Equinox 382YE.

==[[Change of doctrine]]==
No change of doctrine was attempted during the Summit.

==[[Veto]]==
No veto was sought during the Summit.

The Tribune notes that Judgements 7, 15, 19, 59, and 70 are competitive.

Of these five Mandates, Judgement 15 was upheld by the greatest margin, and therefore is the Mandate that will be successful if acted upon.

==[[Recognition]]==
{|
| '''Number''' || '''Assembly''' || '''Judgement''' || '''Raised By'''  || '''Outcome'''
|-
|4 || Courage  || I put forward Asher of Felix’s Watch, former Cardinal of Courage, as a Paragon of Courage. His signs are thus:<br> Inspiration: Many of the Assembly and Highguard still carry Asher’s words as a guiding influence. Abbadon de Rondell and Clarice Novarion of Dawn come to mind as obvious names, as well as Imperial citizens across the Empire - most notably Highguard, Urizen, the Marches and Dawn.<br>Legacy: Tom of Upwold created with spear of Courage known as Oathkeeper, which Asher placed a Hallowing of the Bull (strength of twelve priests) upon with True Liao. Asher also wielded an artefact zweihander called Daring Rescue that encouraged whoever used it to protect those that they had healed, no matter the cost.<br> Miracle: Asher’s body spontaneously vanished from the Chapel in Anvil, leaving behind a spontaneous Courage consecration of the strength of seven priests. His soul was also not traceable via Whispers Through the Black Gate when it was cast to speak with him after his body disappeared.<br>Liberation: When Whispers through the Black Gate was cast to communicate with Asher on his death in Spring 380, rather than his spirit or other entity appearing, the Anointing know as the Purity of Courage spontaneously manifested upon all the ritualists’ souls with the strength of seven priests. This did not disappear as normal but has proven permanent. We hold that the inability to contact Asher’s spirit, his body’s disappearance and the spontaneous permanent auras upon the ritualists and the Chapel as evidence of Asher’s Liberation from the Labyrinth.<br>Recognition: It has been confirmed that Asher was Ruth, wife of Permion, through his True Liao Vision. She was the one who hid the maps leading to the body of Permion with the body of Atuman. A Hallowed artefact brooch belonging to Ruth was recovered, and subsequently worn by Asher until his death. It is currently in the possession of Naomi of Felix’s Watch.<br>Pilgrimage: Asher, following his vision in Spring 377, committed to a two-fold Pilgrimage. First to recover the maps he hid as Ruth, then leading a band of Heroes to recover the body of Permion in Winter 378. || Levitia of Urizen ||  Upheld 177 - 0 <label type="success">Greater Majority</label>
|-
|18 || Recognition: Exemplar.  ||  We recognise Navarr as an Exemplar of Wisdom.<br>She displayed Benevolence in spending her adult life creating the Trods.<br>She displayed Inspiration in the great numbers who flocked to hear her speak and followed her.<br>Her first journeys along the Trods are already recognised as a sign of Pilgrimage in the life of Thorn.<br>Navarr’s Legacy is self-evident: her journeys and teachings founded a nation. || Erasmo di Tassato ||  Upheld 975 - 27.
|-
|}

==Assembly Strength==
 
At the start of the summit the voting total of the General Assembly was calculated to be 2293
 
The final voting total of the General Assembly was estimated to be 2601

The Civil Service reminds citizens that determining whether a Judgement has achieved a Greater Majority counts from the estimation of the assembly strength when scrutiny on the Judgement closes, not the final assembly strength at the end of the summit.
